statement: Pitch-stride output placement. With W=3, H=2, P=5, shiftX=1, shiftY=0, and source S[j*3+i] = (float)(j*3+i), in a 10-element output allocation the candidate must produce O[0]=1.0f, O[1]=2.0f, O[2]=0.0f, O[5]=4.0f, O[6]=5.0f, O[7]=3.0f, and must not write to any element before O[0] or after O[9].
